# STableHeader `<s-table-header>`

Um cabeçalho de coluna em uma tabela. `STableHeader` é o wrapper de Vue 3 tipado do web component `<s-table-header>` do Shopify Polaris.

```ts
import { STableHeader } from 'polaris-vue-elements'
```

## Exemplo

<script setup>
import STableDemo from '../../examples/demos/STableDemo.vue'
</script>

<div class="demo-surface">

<STableDemo />

</div>

```vue
<script setup>
import {
  STable,
  STableHeaderRow,
  STableHeader,
  STableBody,
  STableRow,
  STableCell,
  SBadge,
} from 'polaris-vue-elements'
</script>

<template>
  <STable variant="auto">
    <STableHeaderRow>
      <!-- STableHeader labels a column. `format` styles cell content (e.g. currency),
           and `listSlot` designates its role when the table falls back to `list` layout. -->
      <STableHeader listSlot="primary">Order</STableHeader>
      <STableHeader listSlot="secondary">Customer</STableHeader>
      <STableHeader format="currency">Total</STableHeader>
      <STableHeader>Status</STableHeader>
    </STableHeaderRow>
    <STableBody>
      <STableRow>
        <STableCell>#1001</STableCell>
        <STableCell>Alex Morgan</STableCell>
        <STableCell>$120.00</STableCell>
        <STableCell><SBadge tone="success">Fulfilled</SBadge></STableCell>
      </STableRow>
      <STableRow>
        <STableCell>#1002</STableCell>
        <STableCell>Sam Rivera</STableCell>
        <STableCell>$45.50</STableCell>
        <STableCell><SBadge tone="warning">Pending</SBadge></STableCell>
      </STableRow>
      <STableRow>
        <STableCell>#1003</STableCell>
        <STableCell>Jamie Lee</STableCell>
        <STableCell>$310.25</STableCell>
        <STableCell><SBadge tone="critical">Cancelled</SBadge></STableCell>
      </STableRow>
    </STableBody>
  </STable>
</template>
```

## Props

| Prop | Tipo | Descrição |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | `"base" \| "numeric" \| "currency"` | O formato da coluna, que controla o estilo e o alinhamento do conteúdo das células. |
| `listSlot` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "inline" \| "kicker" \| "labeled"` | A designação de conteúdo desta coluna quando a tabela é exibida na variante de lista em dispositivos móveis. |

## Slots

| Slot | Descrição |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | O título da coluna na variante `table` e o rótulo dos seus dados na variante `list`. |
